scope: Read-only source review of the B1 quote/confirmation slice. No implementation edits, tests, builds, or PostgreSQL processes were started by this review.

findings.detail: The zero-work item now explicitly has task_type=null, no price/version, and zero points while preserving source_quote_id.
SQL retains the original paid source and validates its category independently; only needs_redo=true requires the item task to equal that source category.
visibleRun now rejects archived projects in addition to deleted projects and closed accounts.
The outer exact-request replay branch now reloads the quote response, avoiding a stale null confirmation after another request commits.
SQL M4 fixed-price source/version checks use IS DISTINCT FROM so JSON null cannot bypass the current-price guard.
SQL validates M4 original intent hash/snapshot/reservation points, review intent/input hash and frozen draft revision, and authoring original input/category.

inspections: API canonical body columns and SQL snapshot fields agree; INSERT placeholder/value ordering is consistent.
Captured prior work uses one business-document package at the current price of the original paid category; saved clean/candidate classification cannot lower the original paid task category.
True zero prior work does not require a published current price and does not waive or replace existing paid accounting.
Historical reads and exact confirmed-request replay preserve the immutable quote and confirmation rather than requiring the current active draft or current price.
New confirmation reloads the verified plan/basis and performs live receipt, execution, checkpoint, material, prior-work, current-price and expiry checks.
This slice writes quotes, explicit acceptance and outbox facts only; it does not adopt materials, resume a run, reserve credits or charge a wallet.
remaining: Runtime/API/PostgreSQL acceptance and raw verification logs are owned by the root and SQL/test agents. This source review establishes no execution success or scenario-coverage percentage.
